messages:
benjamin: Hey all — new hire here (Ben). Monitor arrived but the stand/arm wasn’t in the box. Also noticing flaky Wi‑Fi on 6th floor conference area. Who should I ping for a replacement stand and to report the Wi‑Fi? :wave:

mira (IT): hey Ben, welcome! :tada: sorry about that. Can you drop the ticket number if you already filed one? If not, i’ll open one. Also what’s the monitor model/serial?

benjamin: Didn’t see a ticket yet, filing now. Model: ViewSonic VX3276‑2K. Serial on the box is SVX3276‑AB12345. Shipping tracking (from vendor):

Carrier: FastShip
Tracking: FS123456789US

Address is my office desk: Redwood HQ, 6th floor, Desk 6.14, Ben Harper.

mira (IT): got it. I opened a ticket: `IT-2026-4821`. I’ll mark it priority and request a replacement stand from ops. Can you snap a quick photo of the box label and the monitor side w/serial and upload to the ticket? helps speed returns.

benjamin: Uploaded photo to the ticket. Also the Wi‑Fi issue — when i join the office network it drops after ~5 minutes, then reconnects. Happens on my MacBook Air M2 and my phone. No other folks complaining right now.

jamie (office ops): hi! I can ship a VESA stand from our spare parts; should be same‑day pickup. Mira — do we have a spare VX‑mount stand in inventory?

mira (IT): checking inventory now.

logistics-bot: Inventory check complete. Item "VESA‑75 dual mount stand" — qty 4 available in office supply closet.

mira (IT): great — Jamie, can you please prepare one and drop it off to Desk 6.14? I’ll update ticket `IT-2026-4821` with the internal RMA and replacement details. Ben, for the Wi‑Fi i’ll loop in networking — can you share approximate times it happened today so they can pull AP logs?

benjamin: Thanks. Wi‑Fi drop happened at ~09:23 and again ~09:38. Happened while in Zoom. I added that to the ticket.

kacee (office ops): I’ll swing by with the stand in ~30m and leave it at the desk or with reception if you’re not at your desk. If Ben isn’t there, I’ll drop a sticky note. :slightly_smiling_face:

mira (IT): Networking team pinged. They’ll look at the 6th floor APs and correlate with those timestamps. If it’s an AP issue we’ll schedule a swap during low hours.

benjamin: Awesome, thanks everyone. Appreciate the quick turnaround! :thumbsup:

mira (IT): update for the thread: replacement stand prepared by ops and labelled for Ben, expected dropoff in 25‑35m. Ticket `IT-2026-4821` updated with tracking and internal RMA. Networking found intermittent noise on AP‑6F‑02 during your timestamps; engineer will be onsite tomorrow morning for a hardware check.

benjamin: Perfect — I’ll test Wi‑Fi tomorrow and reply on the ticket. Thanks again.

jamie (office ops): stand delivered to Desk 6.14 at 10:12. left a note. :white_check_mark:

benjamin: Received the stand and set it up — works great. Wi‑Fi seems fine this morning too. Closing the loop. :)

mira (IT): Thanks for confirming. Closing ticket `IT-2026-4821` as resolved, re-open if anything else crops up. Welcome aboard, Ben!
